title: 5.2 Food
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals, ask prices and order politely at a café or market.
goal: Name everyday food and say who eats or cooks it: Die Mutter kocht Hähnchen.
grammar_function: Das ist Brot (no article for food you cannot count). Subject + isst/kocht + food.
speaking_outcome: Name food and say who eats or cooks it.
